summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features: CaseModal, SEO files (sitemap.xml/robots.txt), and animated 'G.' SVG brand. All acceptance criteria met on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No console errors, no regressions in language persistence or CV download.

case_modal.modal_content: PASS - year/client type/brief/solution/tech chips/visit+repo links all rendered with correct data-testid
case_modal.gallery_images_load: PASS - all 4 gallery imgs for glops-i-llandes have naturalWidth > 0 (1600, 1600, 599, 363)
case_modal.close_via_escape: PASS (modal removed after exit animation ~1s, body.overflow restored to '')
case_modal.close_via_overlay_click: PASS (clicked outside panel at top area)
case_modal.body_scroll_lock: PASS (document.body.style.overflow='hidden' while open, restored to '' after close)
case_modal.en_translations: PASS - modal in EN shows 'The brief', 'What I did', 'More project views', 'Visit site'

seo_files.sitemap_xml: PASS - status 200, contains <urlset> with correct site URL loc
seo_files.robots_txt: PASS - status 200, Cloudflare managed content at top followed by our lines at end: 'User-agent: *', 'Allow: /', 'Sitemap: https://.../sitemap.xml'

svg_brand.svg_present: PASS - svg.nav__brand-svg with text.nav__brand-g containing 'G.' rendered and visible after ~2.5s

regression.lang_persistence_reload: PASS - localStorage 'gmp-lang' persists after reload (EN stays active)
regression.mobile_390x844_modal: PASS - modal single-column layout, panel 366x776, gallery stacked correctly

critical_code_review_comments: vite.config.js seoFiles plugin: env.VITE_SITE_URL is not defaulted; if missing at build time, sitemap.xml would emit 'undefined/' as loc. Consider a fallback or a warning if VITE_SITE_URL is not set.
CaseModal focus trap not implemented — closeRef only receives initial focus; keyboard Tab can escape the modal to background content. Minor a11y improvement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (case modal + SEO + animated G brand) working perfectly on desktop and mobile. iteration_1 regression items also passing. If retesting is needed, focus on VITE_SITE_URL config in production build.
